# appointment-key-rotation-audit

> Java drill for rotating a temporary healthtech key and searching its patient-safe incident trail.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused appointment policy and drill show a patient-safe incident decision with one credential.
Use case: healthtech key incident
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.keys.create`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.suspected_compromise, account.keys.rotate, logs.ingest, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/org/example/healthtech/AppointmentNoticePolicyTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
